name: TweenLightRadius
description: An extension to smoothly tween the radius of a Light object over time. Supports standard easing functions, tween identifiers, and lifecycle management (pause, resume, stop).
shortDescription: Advanced tweening for a light's radius.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: LightRadiusTweener
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Attach this to a Light object to tween its radius.

eventsFunctions.name: TweenRadius
eventsFunctions.description: Tween the radius of the light object to a new value.

eventsFunctions.name: IsPlaying
eventsFunctions.description: Check if a radius tween is currently playing.

eventsFunctions.name: HasFinished
eventsFunctions.description: Check if a radius tween has finished playing.

eventsFunctions.name: Exists
eventsFunctions.description: Check if a radius tween exists.

eventsFunctions.name: StopTween
eventsFunctions.description: Stop a radius tween on the light.

eventsFunctions.name: PauseTween
eventsFunctions.description: Pause a radius tween on the light.

eventsFunctions.name: ResumeTween
eventsFunctions.description: Resume a paused radius tween on the light.

eventsFunctions.name: RemoveTween
eventsFunctions.description: Remove a radius tween on the light.

eventsFunctions.name: Progress
eventsFunctions.description: Get the progress of a radius tween (from 0 to 1).
